 HoopsHype Oct. 11, 2026, 11:08 a.m. ET NBA Trade Machine: De'Aaron Fox was part of 6.3% of the trades built on HoopsMatic over the past 24 hours. Of those trades, his top destinations were Detroit (10.3%), Minnesota (10.3%), and Chicago (10.3%). The most common players sent back for him were Cade Cunningham (10.3%), Anthony Edwards (10.3%), and Nicolas Claxton (10.3%).
